description: This multi-level pie or donut chart represents a hierarchical categorization of tasks or capabilities, divided into an inner ring with three primary categories and an outer ring with nine specific subcategories. The inner ring consists of three slices with white text labels placed directly inside them: "Contradiction Resolution" (brown), "Context Tracking" (dark blue), and "Context Retrieving" (dark teal). The outer ring contains nine slices, which are visually grouped and color-coordinated with the adjacent inner categories. Aligned with the brown "Contradiction Resolution" slice are three red-toned slices: a light red slice labeled "Prioritization" (with the text partially obscured by a grey blur) showing a value of 100, an orange-red slice for "Personalization" at 100, and a bright red slice for "Privacy Protection" at 111. Aligned with the dark blue "Context Tracking" slice are three blue-toned slices: a light blue slice for "Triggering" at 100, a medium blue slice for "Recursive Reasoning" at 110, and a dark blue slice for "Dynamic Environment" at 100. Aligned with the dark teal "Context Retrieving" slice are three green and cyan-toned slices: a light cyan slice for "Memorization" at 100, a turquoise slice for "Dynamic Instruction" at 100, and a green slice for "Multitasking" at 160. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the outer subcategories are labeled outside the chart with text and numerical values connected to their respective slices by thin blue lines. The slices are separated by prominent white borders around a central white hole, and no individual slices are exploded or offset. The segments are not ordered by descending size, but are instead grouped by their overarching inner ring category, with the physical size of the outer slices visually corresponding to their displayed numerical values.
